selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were retained; the release-native LVM2 2.02.26 package was used.
Boot-time dm_mod loading, rcS LVM activation/mounting, and the noauto fstab entry were configured. This is supporting configuration evidence only.

The healthy baseline and boot ID af07932d-bfd9-4ae7-aa6b-57a2c7a230b2 were captured; reboot acknowledgement returned; SSH then became unavailable and remained refused through the final poll. A changed boot ID and recovered storage could not be observed.
